items.prompt: In non-ANSI (1995) style, port directions are declared…
items.explain: The port list is names only; input/output/inout follow inside the module.

items.prompt: ANSI (2001) port lists put direction and width…
choices: In the module header port list
items.explain: ANSI headers carry input/output/inout, type, and ranges in one place.

items.prompt: output reg q in an ANSI header replaces non-ANSI…
choices: output q; plus reg q; in the body
items.explain: ANSI can declare a procedural output as output reg in the header.

items.prompt: ANSI and non-ANSI styles change the synthesized hardware for the same assign logic.
items.explain: It is a declaration style difference; equivalent modules elaborate the same way.
